PQ/Growth exclusions remain explicit for the Legacy optimization. Newly reached modules and runtime behavior require their separate validation; the curated seven-route scopes are not expanded. The composed source also dispatches Growth history/confirmation observations to their explicit backend and refuses the legacy non-Sync confirmation callback for Growth. R2 consistently renames the private InitializeOrRecover observation field and leaves ExistingPqOwner mapped to (false, true); no wire or persisted schema changes arise from that naming repair.
